[{"file": "src/main/java/org/mockito/Mock.java", "line": 122, "category": "bug", "severity": "medium", "comment": "Defaulting to `Strictness.STRICT_STUBS` means every `@Mock` field carries an explicit strictness, so there is no way to express \"not specified\". Any mock declared with this annotation will therefore claim STRICT_STUBS even when the surrounding runner/session was configured with a different strictness, silently changing behavior for existing users. A dedicated \"not set\" default would preserve the current semantics."}, {"file": "src/main/java/org/mockito/Mock.java", "line": 117, "category": "design", "severity": "medium", "comment": "This attribute overlaps with the existing `lenient()` attribute above, and the javadoc does not say what happens when both are given (e.g. `@Mock(lenient = true, strictness = Strictness.STRICT_STUBS)`). Either document the precedence or reject the conflicting combination; ideally `lenient()` is deprecated in favor of `strictness()`."}]
